symbols.name: control vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of control values, with one entry $x_T$ for each triple $T$.
symbols.quote: Write $x$ for the control vector, with entries $x_T$, and $y$ for the target vector, with entries $y_S$.

symbols.name: target vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of target values, with one entry $y_S$ for each triple $S$.
symbols.quote: Write $x$ for the control vector, with entries $x_T$, and $y$ for the target vector, with entries $y_S$.

symbols.name: starting side values
symbols.meaning: The starting values of the side wires $W_{ST}$.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for the starting values of the side wires and $c$ for those of the central wires.

symbols.name: starting central values
symbols.meaning: The starting values of the central wires $C_\ell$.
symbols.quote: Write $a$ for the starting values of the side wires and $c$ for those of the central wires.

symbols.name: copy operator
symbols.meaning: The operator that adds each control value $x_T$ to the side wire $W_{ST}$ of each neighbouring pair $(S,T)$.

symbols.name: side injection
symbols.meaning: The operator that adds to $y_S$ the side wires $W_{ST}$ summed over the neighbours $T$ of $S$.
symbols.quote: $J$ is side injection, which adds to $y_S$ the side wires $W_{ST}$ over the neighbours $T$ of $S$.

symbols.name: gather operator
symbols.meaning: The operator that adds each control value $x_T$ to every central wire $C_\ell$ with $\ell$ in $T$.
symbols.quote: $G$ is gather, which adds $x_T$ to each $C_\ell$ with $\ell\in T$.

symbols.name: scatter operator
symbols.meaning: The operator that adds to $y_S$ the central wires $C_\ell$ summed over the elements $\ell$ of $S$.
symbols.quote: $R$ is scatter, which adds to $y_S$ the central wires $C_\ell$ with $\ell\in S$.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, indexing a target value $y_S$.
symbols.quote: The letters $S$ and $T$ denote triples, three-element subsets of the ground set, and two triples are neighbours when they share exactly one element.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, indexing a control value $x_T$.
symbols.quote: The letters $S$ and $T$ denote triples, three-element subsets of the ground set, and two triples are neighbours when they share exactly one element.

symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire of a neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ of triples.
symbols.quote: Each neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ has a side wire $W_{ST}$, and each element $\ell$ of the ground set has a central wire $C_\ell$.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The auxiliary wire attached to the element $\ell$ of the ground set.
symbols.quote: Each neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ has a side wire $W_{ST}$, and each element $\ell$ of the ground set has a central wire $C_\ell$.

symbols.name: ground element
symbols.meaning: An element of the ground set, indexing the central wires $C_\ell$.
symbols.quote: Each neighbouring pair $(S,T)$ has a side wire $W_{ST}$, and each element $\ell$ of the ground set has a central wire $C_\ell$.
